So the feed can put a sentence of the periodical page in front of a researcher; it cannot put the page there. known_query_traps: title:("wal-mart") does NOT match an item titled 'Walmart Stores' — hyphen/quote tokenisation is unreliable, so always OR the hyphenless form.

Unscoped conjunctions (walmart AND "annual report" AND YEAR:[..]) return token noise (CIA reading-room documents, Compute! magazine). numFound>0 from such a query is NOT evidence — that is WR-17 of the Walmart retest.
archive.org/download/<id>/<file> 302s to a CDN whose TLS certificate is expired from this network; use the server+dir route recorded above.
